name: kdua-mobile
title: KDUA-Mobile: Ukrainian mobile keystroke dynamics with motion sensors
description: 498 typing sessions from 71 people on 56 Android phones: key press and release timings, per-key touch geometry, and four motion sensor streams at a requested 200 Hz. Ukrainian text on the YTsUKEN layout.

contributors.title: S. V. Yevtushenko
contributors.organization: National University "Odesa Law Academy", Department of Cybersecurity

sources.title: Collected with a custom Android input method; see docs/collection_protocol.md

fields.name: participant_id
fields.description: Random identifier, unique per device, not per person.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: The same person across devices. Derived at packaging; the participant number itself is not published.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: Random identifier, stable across participants on the same phone.

fields.name: own_device
fields.description: own or borrowed. Typing on an unfamiliar phone differs systematically; a covariate, not noise.

fields.name: density_dpi
fields.description: Needed for any conversion of pixels to millimetres.

fields.name: sensor_hardware
fields.description: JSON array, one object per sensor: type, name, vendor, model, nominal rate, resolution, range.

fields.name: best_sensor_delay_us
fields.description: Fastest rate any sensor on this device can deliver; an emulator reports 200 ms across the board.

fields.name: screen_diag_in
fields.description: Physical screen diagonal, used with the above to detect emulated devices.

resources.name: sessions
resources.description: One row per session, with the quality fields.

fields.name: task_code
fields.description: transcribe_ua, fixed_phrase or free_ua. See docs/stimuli.md.

fields.name: privacy_mode
fields.description: KEY_ID or CLASS_ONLY. In CLASS_ONLY the key identity and absolute touch geometry are not published.

fields.name: hold_style
fields.description: The grip ASKED OF the participant, not the one observed. Filter on motion_active_fraction instead.

fields.name: guided_step
fields.description: Position in the guided sequence, 1 to 6. Step 1 is familiarisation and is excluded from analysis.

fields.name: guided_order
fields.description: Which row of the 3x3 Latin square this participant received.

fields.name: started_at_utc
fields.description: Date of the session. Published to the day only; see docs/privacy.md.

fields.name: started_nanos
fields.description: elapsedRealtimeNanos at session start: nanoseconds since the device booted, not wall clock.

fields.name: sensor_sample_count
fields.description: Zero means the sensor stream never started; the session is usable for keystroke features only.

fields.name: quality
fields.description: JSON array, per sensor: sample count, achieved rate, nominal rate, largest gap.

fields.name: gyro_samples
fields.description: Zero means the device has no gyroscope, not that it was still.

fields.name: external_input
fields.description: The field disagreed with the recorded events. Empty in sessions older than schema 9: not checked, not clean.

fields.name: motion_active_fraction
fields.description: Share of gyroscope samples in which the device was moving. Empty where it cannot be computed.

fields.name: quality_flag
fields.description: ok in the published build; the other values exist in the non-strict build.

resources.name: key_events
resources.description: One row per key press or release.

fields.name: action
fields.description: down or up. No cancel events occur in this corpus.

fields.name: key_class
fields.description: LETTER, DIGIT, PUNCT, SPACE, BACKSPACE, SHIFT, ENTER, LAYOUT. Always present.

fields.name: key_code
fields.description: Unicode code point of the unshifted character. Empty for backspace and in CLASS_ONLY sessions.

fields.name: touch_x
fields.description: Fraction of the keyboard view, 0 to 1, not pixels.

fields.name: offset_x
fields.description: Touch displacement from the key centre, normalised by key size. Present in CLASS_ONLY as well.

fields.name: pressure
fields.description: Constant on most Android digitisers; see docs/quality.md before using it.

fields.name: key_w
fields.description: Key width in view pixels, unlike touch_x which is a fraction.

fields.name: t_rel_ns
fields.description: Nanoseconds since session start. Use this unless you have a reason not to.

resources.name: sensors
resources.description: One Parquet file per session, named by session_id: columns session_id, sensor_name, t_nanos, t_recv_nanos, x, y, z, w, accuracy, t_rel_ns. 495 files; three sessions produced no sensor data and therefore no file.

resources.name: keystrokes
resources.description: Derived: one row per key press with its hold time.

resources.name: digraphs
resources.description: Derived: one row per adjacent pair of presses with DD, UD, UU, DU.

resources.name: verification_protocol
resources.description: The fixed verification experiment: enrolment and probe sessions per record, and every pair to be scored, labelled by kind.
